scientific_integrity: Proof reconstructed and exhaustive cases checked. Independent external audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only ordered commuting square-zero triples in the radical of a bounded diamond incidence algebra, m >= 1; no claim for full incidence algebra, arbitrary posets, unordered triples or longer tuples. Primary source concerns incidence-algebra multiplication, not this enumeration. Literature coverage is qualified by abstract-only sources.
title: Characteristic-sensitive counts of commuting square-zero triples in diamond incidence algebras
